address: Callejon Aldama 101, Ruta Independencia, Barrio de Xochimilco, Oaxaca, 68040, Mexico
bio: Don't come to Adama expecting traditional Mexican cooking. Instead, this welcoming spot specializes in Middle Eastern cuisine. Tucked away down Callejon Adama street, this restaurant entices the city's growing population of foreigners making their home in this creative, colorful city. Chef Hagar Aviram may set a laidback tone here, but her cooking is spot on, reflecting authentic. The tightly edited menu features a number of dishes intended for sharing. Ingredients are sourced locally from nearby farms for simple, authentic plates like falafel with tahini and lamb kebab. End on a sweet note with baklava and a Turkish coffee....
